description: List statutory EU compliance dates from bundled Official Journal acts. Use this to discover ids for compliance_get_deadline; tenders_list_deadline_changes handles procurement deadlines and funding_list_changes handles grants. Filters narrow together; omitted filters return all dates ordered by date then id, without pagination. Returns as_of, verified, count, laws and deadlines with obligation, date, days_until, status, source URL/quote/SHA-256 and history. The verified date bounds legal freshness; days_until is calculated today, not proof of a fresh legal review. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

law.description: Known law name (case-insensitive), e.g. CBAM or EUDR; only laws in the returned laws list are accepted; omit for all laws

status.description: upcoming or applies Allowed: upcoming, applies; e.g. upcoming.

to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2027-12-31. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: compliance_list_deadlines
title: List EU compliance deadlines
